judge.notes: The front page follows the brief closely: every story is a white bordered card with a bold underlined title, a domain pill tag, and a points/author/age/comments line along the bottom, in a 4-across grid at 1280px that collapses to a single column at 375px. The thread page nests comments as cards with a visible left indent, though the nesting bars are faint and deep replies get cramped. Grid cards leave ragged empty space under shorter entries, and the 1280px grid ends with a half-empty final row. Overall the page shape is clearly distinct from the live table.
